edit.description: Emit stamps the engine version that wrote the lock: `write_rollup` (the sole lock writer, :582) writes `crate::VERSION` into the document, and the read side lifts it back. Spell it OUTSIDE the `[declaration]` table — `declarations_from_doc` (:4675) and the embedded `src/builtin_lock.toml` are declaration rows only, and the frozen lane byte-compares exactly those rows. Per 0024's robust read: an older lock carrying no engine key is legitimate absence — `Option`, never a `LockRowError`, never a synthesized value.
The round-trip pin: an emitted lock names this engine's version, and a lock text with the key absent still parses to the same declarations with the engine unknown.

`projection_tree` (:241) renders `.temper/lock.toml` verbatim into the snapshot, so a bare version line would churn the snapshot on every release bump — normalize the stamped line (insta filter or a redaction in the renderer) so the snapshot pins the key's presence, not the release.
The embedded `.temper/lock.toml` (:87) gains the engine line in whatever normalized spelling the renderer above settles on.

summary: The committed lock names the engine version that wrote it; a lock without the key reads as unknown, never as an error.

tests.asserts: an emitted lock carries the running engine's version; a lock text lacking the key parses with the engine absent and every declaration family intact
the projection-tree snapshot stays stable across a version bump — the rendered lock's engine line is normalized, not the literal string

acceptance: cargo test green (the gauntlet snapshot accepted), cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean, and `cargo fmt --all --check` clean.
notes: Decision 0069, first consequence. The read face's one consumer is ENGINE-MISMATCH-IS-A-ROOT-CLAUSE, filed with this entry as its blocked successor — the chain is declared up front rather than shipping an export that earns its consumer a tick later. Do not touch `.temper/lock.toml`: the dogfood's lock is harness territory, and its missing key is exactly the legitimate absence this entry must tolerate. scoped at 1c049fae
